start: Menu, Visits (title 'Visits', 'Who trained, and when'), tab 'Register'

steps.action: Under 'Check someone in' type a name or the last 4 digits of a mobile
user_sees: The member row with photo or initials, a plan-state pill and '<amount> due' when money is owed
Button 'Check in'
must_not: An expired plan or dues hides the member or blocks the check-in

user_sees: 'Saving…' on the button, then '✓ Already in'
The member in the day's register with an 'Undo' button; tiles 'Visits in N days', 'Busiest hour' move
must_not: Two visits for one member on one day

start: Visits, tab 'Losing the habit' (the count rides on the chip)

user_sees: Subtitle 'Paying members who are losing the habit'
Rows with a risk pill, 'Usually <hour>' and 'Last visit <n> weeks ago'
Empty: 'Everybody is training' or 'Start checking members in'
must_not: A member listed only because visits were never added

user_sees: WhatsApp opens on that member's number in a new tab; the desk types and sends by hand
must_not: A message sent by itself, or WhatsApp opening on a wrong or code-less number

start: Visits, button 'Pass visits' (shown only once the gym has a pass member or pass visit)

user_sees: Title 'Pass visits', 'Visits by FITPASS, cultpass and other pass members'
'Month' picker, tiles 'Pass visits' and 'Pass members who came', a table by pass company
Empty: 'No pass visits in <month>'
must_not: A normal member's visit counted as a pass visit

user_sees: A CSV file downloads; 'Exported N pass visits.' (or 'Exported 1 pass visit.')
must_not: A count in the file that differs from the tile

user_sees: 'Nobody matches that' with the button 'Open Members'
must_not: A new member made silently

steps.action: Pick another day and type a future date
user_sees: 'That day hasn't happened yet.'
'Pick a day first' / 'Pick a day that has already passed. Then the check-in box comes back.'; the check-in box is hidden
must_not: A check-in saved on a future day, or landing on today without a word

start: Visits, Register, a member already checked in

user_sees: The row leaves the register; the member shows 'Check in' again
must_not: Another day's visit removed, or the at-risk list still counting the undone visit

steps.action: Choose yesterday and check the same member in
user_sees: A loud amber banner saying which day is being recorded
must_not: The visit saved on today

steps.action: Export the list (greyed 'Needs internet' while offline)
user_sees: A CSV with the listed members and their phone numbers
must_not: Members of another gym or branch in the file; staff getting numbers the owner filtered out
